lessons.title: Use Proper Optimization Setup
lessons.summary: Setting up the optimization problem with correct bounds and objective functions leads to better results.
lessons.lesson: Define the optimization problem with clear bounds and objective function, using appropriate solvers like L-BFGS-B or ECOS.

lessons.title: Avoid Syntax Errors
lessons.summary: Correctly formatting code and ensuring all brackets and imports are properly closed prevents runtime errors.
lessons.lesson: Ensure all list brackets are closed and all imported modules are correctly referenced to avoid syntax errors.

lessons.title: Use Gradient-Based Optimization
lessons.summary: Gradient-based methods can efficiently find better solutions by adjusting parameters in the direction of steepest descent.
lessons.lesson: Apply gradient-based optimization techniques like L-BFGS-B to iteratively refine the solution by minimizing the overlap integral.

lessons.title: Ensure Proper Constraint Handling
lessons.summary: Enforcing the integral constraint is crucial for valid solutions in optimization problems.
lessons.lesson: Normalize the solution after optimization to ensure the integral constraint is satisfied by scaling the solution to the required sum.

lessons.title: Avoid Incompatible Data Structures
lessons.summary: Using incompatible data structures can lead to runtime errors and failed computations.
lessons.lesson: Verify that all array operations and function outputs maintain consistent dimensions and data types to prevent shape mismatches and errors.
